purpose: Teach: 国名/軽自動車/預ける/最大手/料率/概論/役務/全日空

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外案件は正式な国名表記で統一しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're using formal country names consistently for all our overseas projects.
lines.style: Efficient and clear. Quick decisive attack on the opening. Brisk pace, no hesitation. The tone of someone used to running a checklist: this is item one.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社用の軽自動車を新規導入しました
lines.en: Got it. We've brought in the new company vehicles—the light commercial ones.
lines.style: Affirmative and prompt. Slight upbeat inflection on the acknowledgment. Ready-to-move-on tone. Speaking from a position of having just completed the task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様の手荷物を預ける場所を整備しましょう
lines.en: And let's set up a proper place for our valued clients to leave their bags.
lines.style: Directive but not demanding. Measured pace. The 'let's' is inclusive—pointing the direction without pushiness. Steady, organized voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界最大手の戦略を分析中です
lines.en: Done. I'm currently running through the market strategy of the industry leader.
lines.style: Status update delivered with quiet confidence. Slight emphasis on 'currently' to show active progress. Professional, matter-of-fact rhythm.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 保険会社の料率比較表を作りましょう
lines.en: Let's put together a rate comparison table for the insurance companies we're considering.
lines.style: Another directive, same measured authority as before. Clean, forward-moving tone. No ambiguity—this is what needs to happen next.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人向け経営概論の教材を準備しました
lines.en: Already done. I've prepared the training materials for the new hires' management overview.
lines.style: Quick confirmation with a note of accomplishment. Efficient delivery. The slight satisfaction of having stayed ahead of the agenda.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 外注の役務範囲を明確にしましょう
lines.en: We need to clarify the exact scope of work for our outsourced partners.
lines.style: Clear, methodical directive. Emphasize the word 'clarify'—this is about precision, not vagueness. Controlled, professional tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。全日空のマイレージを社員に共有しました
lines.en: Done. I've added the ANA mileage account to the company-wide staff share.
lines.style: Final item, wrapped cleanly. Brief, satisfied conclusion. Slight settling into finality—the checklist is complete. Relaxed confidence.
